tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon measurements show the predicted positive-to-negative reversal through the target horizon. Fit all four dual-exponential parameters numerically and use fresh confirmation to test generalization.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed s_grad values are zero, so its gradient-dependent parameter is unidentifiable; the verified simpler dual-exponential mechanism directly explains the observed reversal.
The observed sustained long-horizon reversal and authorized adaptation signature favor the dual-horizon mechanism over a periodic snapshot readout.
The acquired probe supplies three long-horizon observations in addition to five pilot rows, sufficient to fit the four-parameter candidate before fresh confirmation.
